objective: Distinguish frozen predictor errors, inappropriate goal geometry, and CEM action-selection effects before choosing a steering mechanism.

prior_checkpoint.action_responsive_subspace: Four seen development states, 64 fixed plans, nine arms; all retain native choices and zero selected physical gain; completed and two-host verified.
prior_checkpoint.normalization_aware_subspace: One of four states gains 1.840154 percentage points in requested coverage; mean 0.460039 points; fails frozen continuation rule. Completed and two-host verified.
prior_checkpoint.objective_alignment: Actual future encodings still do not select the physically best plans in three of four states. Perfect forecasting alone is not a task-utility oracle. Completed and two-host verified.

trials.hypothesis: The untouched complement of the old PCA16 task metric overwhelms its learned in-span action rankings.
trials.change: Remove the complement while keeping previously frozen metric weights and basis unchanged; compare unweighted span, complement alone, full native cost, old learned full cost and old rotated controls, on predicted and actual-encoding channels.
trials.cap: 180 CPU analysis seconds; no model or simulator calls
trials.primary: Requested-goal coverage of selected candidate, equal weight per development state
trials.gate: Exploratory allocation only: mean gain at least 1 percentage point, positive in at least three of four states, and better mean than corresponding matched control. All old weight families and controls retained, no refit.

trials.hypothesis: CEM elite averaging or iterative refinement produces worse physical outcomes than its lowest-model-cost sampled plan.
trials.change: Native Push CEM H6, 300 candidates, 30 iterations, 10 elites; compare mean and best CURRENT candidate at fixed iterations 1,15,30 through paired simulator forks. Native-versus-instrumented full-CEM identity canary precedes remaining runs.
trials.cap: 600 aggregate process seconds; one uninstrumented canary plus four instrumented CEM runs. Stop at technical or projected budget failure, never silently shrink native search.
trials.primary: Iteration30 requested-goal H6 coverage difference, mean minus lowest-model-cost candidate, for each of four states
trials.secondary: Executed-prefix effects, intermediate iterations/horizons, actual prediction errors, action distributions, selected cost and XY distance
trials.interpretation: A causal planner-selection diagnostic, not a full closed-loop performance study. Negative or mixed differences do not justify selecting stages post hoc.

trials.hypothesis: Action proposal contraction and elite-mean displacement characterize when the search changes behavior.
trials.change: Outcome-independent descriptive analysis of saved elites: proposal entropy, participation rank, mean-to-nearest-elite distance and mean update norm.
trials.cap: Local CPU only, no additional model or physics calls
trials.interpretation: No claim that action-space spread is world-model uncertainty, that low entropy is failure, or that mean separation proves multimodality or off-manifold behavior.

new_data_policy: Four additional distinct official Push TRAIN initial-state groups may be allocated deterministically by source metadata with no outcome screening. Preparation is allowed; model or simulator execution has a separate recorded resource cap. Existing held confirmation and scripted-goal reserve remain untouched.

literature.lesson: Separate goal cost from search rule. Equivalent predictive coordinates need not preserve Euclidean goal ordering. Open-loop learned planner results are not directly our closed-loop benchmark.

Action optimization through frozen predictions can use a physical descriptor cost, but requires an auxiliary decoder and numerical goal descriptor; gains confound several planner components unless ablated.

ACID adds inverse-action consistency along the imagined path. Defer implementation until an inverse readout works on real held-development transitions. Zero inverse residual alone cannot certify forward physical accuracy; action ambiguity and inverse-model error are confounds.

integrity: All current four-state analyses are adaptive exploratory evidence, not new independent confirmations. No success claim from proxy movement alone. Preserve source/failed trials; validate exact targets, goals and action transformations; independent instances only under project leases. No new paid rentals or lifecycle changes.
